da-non-sequitur.evidence: Part (1) of the statement writes H_n(R,q) = End_{B_n}(V^{otimes n}). H_n maps onto the Temperley-Lieb quotient, and End_{B_n} is the commutant of the braid action, so the identification is not right as stated. Part (3) uses "inclusions induced by the unit eta: 1 -> V", but Hom(1, V) = 0 for the fundamental of SU_q(2), so eta = 0 and the direct limit is not defined as written. The proof inherits both.

Re-review after 83d5ee4bf. Both earlier narrative errors are fixed: H_n now maps onto TL_n ≅ End, and ι_n(x) = x⊗v₀ with v₀≠0 intertwines H_n with its restriction. Remaining: part (3) 'summands labelled by knot types span V_phys' is immediate from complete decomposition, but knot types do not label summands (a closure's trace has support on several λ, and many knots share a λ), so 'complete eigenbasis' is not shown; the closing Feynman-integral sentence is interpretation inside a proposition.

Re-review after #8075. Part (2) is now detection of each S_λ (ℓ≤2) by some closure, shown by the trivial braid since χ_λ(1) = dim S_λ ≠ 0; this relies on y_λ ≠ 0 for two-row λ, which the proof states rather than computes (true under convention D, where only three-row weights vanish). Part (3) spanning follows from complete decomposition of each V^⊗n. The overclaim 'knot types form an eigenbasis' is no longer in the statement.
